# ChemPoint

> > ChemPoint is a specialty chemistry and ingredients B2B marketplace connecting manufacturers and customers across diverse industrial sectors.

ChemPoint operates as a comprehensive digital platform for industrial chemical distribution and supplier discovery, serving manufacturers and customers in adhesives, agriculture, coatings, personal care, pharmaceuticals, and 10+ other major industries. The platform aggregates products from leading chemical suppliers including BASF, Dow, DuPont, and Huntsman, facilitating B2B transactions and partnerships at scale.
